fx.modeLabel: How the amount in {budget} is worked out
fx.rateHelp: Exactly as you saw it (for example {example}).
fx.rateFromTrip: This is the rate of the trip “{trip}”, written for {date}.
fx.feeHelp: What your card charges abroad; 0 if it charges nothing.
fx.actualHelp: Check your statement: that figure wins and the rate comes from the two amounts.
fx.rounding: Rounded once, to the nearest cent.
fx.error.currency: Choose the currency you paid in.
fx.error.rate: Enter the rate as an exact number, for example {example}. No rate, no amount: you can also use what the bank charged.
fx.error.noAmount: That rate doesn't give a valid amount in {budget}.
fx.stats.title: Spent by currency
fx.stats.intro: What you paid in another currency counts in {budget} with each transaction’s rate; here you also see it in the currency you paid in. Refunds subtract.
fx.boc.title: Bank of Canada rates
fx.boc.toggle: Get rates from the Bank of Canada
fx.boc.toggleHelp: Off, Clara connects to no site. On, asking for a rate sends only the currency and two dates to www.bankofcanada.ca: nothing of yours (no amounts, merchants or accounts).
fx.boc.what: These are indicative rates: the daily average the bank publishes on business days around 4:30 p.m. (Ottawa time), not what your card charges. Clara uses the last business day published up to the date of the expense; if you know what the bank charged, that figure wins.
fx.boc.where: It is offered in “Paid in another currency” when there is no written trip rate and, in the iPhone app, it converts captured payments in another currency, which stay “To check”. Offline there is no rate: nothing is made up.
fx.boc.cache: Rates already fetched are kept on this device, outside your data and backups.
fx.boc.source: Source: Bank of Canada (terms of use at bankofcanada.ca/terms).
fx.boc.onlyCad: Only with a budget in Canadian dollars: the bank publishes its rates in CAD and your budget is in {budget}.
fx.boc.use: Use the Bank of Canada rate
fx.boc.loading: Getting the rate from the Bank of Canada…
fx.boc.notice: Indicative Bank of Canada rate of {date}.
fx.boc.none: The Bank of Canada published no {currency} rate between {from} and {date}. Enter the rate or use what the bank charged.
fx.boc.offline: Could not reach the Bank of Canada: no rate. Enter the rate or use what the bank charged.
fx.boc.error: The Bank of Canada sent a reply Clara does not understand: no rate. Enter the rate or use what the bank charged.
fx.boc.unsupported: The Bank of Canada publishes no daily {currency} rate.
